issues.detail: The skill is macOS-specific and relies on Xcode tools, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: build-and-screenshot
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required xcodebuild, install, launch, log stream, and screenshot commands (though the screenshot filename differs), whereas Response A lacks the build step and uses a different screenshot path.

scenarios.name: crash-report
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but omits the explicit --console-pty flag, while Response B lacks the required simctl launch and devicectl commands.

scenarios.name: lldb-backtrace
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the simctl launch requirement and outputs a backtrace, while Response A fails to use simctl and thus misses a key rubric element.
